_note: Verified source map for the City of Austin stance wave (probed 2026-08-19). Every URL here returned HTTP 200 with the stated story count on page 1 — none are guessed. Austin Monitor tag slugs are irregular: Watson's is a STALE 'state-senator-' label from his Texas Senate days, Ellis and Harper-Madison carry a 'council-member-' prefix, and Vela's uses his full 'jose-chito-vela' form. Do not guess these; they were found by scraping tag links out of article markup after 4 of 11 guessed slugs 404'd.

_sources_ruled_out.legistar_api: https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/austintexas — agenda index ONLY. /eventitems/{id}/votes returns [], /matters/{id}/sponsors returns [], /matters/{id}/histories returns 0 rows, and 0 of 30 published 2025 council meetings carry a minutes file. Proves an instrument exists; carries NO attribution. Cannot seat a chair on its own.
_sources_ruled_out.austintexas_gov_district_pages: https://www.austintexas.gov/district-N — ~4-5k chars, all site chrome, zero positional content.
_sources_ruled_out.austin_monitor_onsite_search: https://austinmonitor.com/?s= — returns unrelated results; use the tag archives below instead.

message_board.access: Incapsula WAF — curl gets a JS interstitial at HTTP 200. Playwright passes.
message_board.caveat: Posting is open to council members AND authorized staff. Staff posts are quarantined to _staff-authored/ and must never be attributed to a member. Some staff write in the officeholder's first-person voice: the Mayor's chief of staff (Colleen Pate, 240 topics) opens threads as 'I' and members reply 'Mayor, ...'. That is evidence ABOUT Watson, not a quote FROM him.
message_board.quirk: viewtopic.php IGNORES ?start= and viewforum.php CLAMPS it — both re-serve a page rather than returning empty, so any offset loop must terminate on 'no new ids', never on an empty batch.

austin_monitor_tags._counting_note: stories_page1 counts recorded earlier were INFLATED. Every tag page carries an identical five-item "most read" widget (your-ultimate-guide, austin-growth-is-slowing, council-hears-plan-to-overhaul, hyde-park-quarries, most-austin-area-drivers) that is not tagged content. tagged_stories below excludes it. Real corpus is ~75 articles across all 11, not ~130.
austin_monitor_tags._yield_note: Measured on a full pass: 2 seatable rows from 11 archives (Watson local-environment, Qadri residential-zoning). Four candidates were checked and rejected — Watson public-safety (his DPS-patrol position reversed within months), Qadri housing (the reporter states outright he would not give specifics), Harper-Madison public-safety (her quote is about City Hall/APD relations, not budget allocation) and Harper-Madison homelessness (encampment siting equity, off the services-vs-enforcement axis, and dated 2021). The archives skew to annual "what will X focus on" profiles, which give direction more often than magnitude.

ballotpedia_candidate_connection._note: Detector warning: EVERY Ballotpedia page contains the boilerplate strings 'Candidate Connection' and 'Campaign themes', so testing for those returns a uniform true and is a BROKEN detector. The discriminating signal is a real 'Key messages' block. Positive control: Mike_Siegel (first-person climate prose). Negative control: Kirk_Watson (nothing). 'has not yet completed' also appears on both and is likewise boilerplate.
ballotpedia_candidate_connection.access: Cross-origin fetch is CORS-blocked; navigate to the origin first, then same-origin fetch.

press_free_to_read: https://www.texastribune.org  (nonprofit newsroom; WebFetch got a 403 on one article — retry or use KUT)
https://austinmonitor.com  (carries subscribe language; tag archives were readable)

council_voting_record.what: Socrata open dataset, no auth and no WAF. 71,885 per-member roll-call rows from 2023 forward. This is the per-member attribution Legistar does not publish.
council_voting_record.join: voter_name matches essentials.politicians.full_name EXACTLY for all 11 current seats, including diacritics and quoted nicknames (José "Chito" Vela, Zohaib "Zo" Qadri). The harvester still asserts the match and reports drift rather than trusting it.
council_voting_record.signal: 63,960 of 71,885 votes are Yes. Unanimous items cannot separate members, so only the 143 items where a CURRENT member cast a recorded No or Abstain are useful. Absent / Off Dais / Withdrawn are not positions.
council_voting_record.caveat: A vote names an instrument and a position but carries NO reasoning, and many items are contract authorisations where a No may be about cost, process or timing rather than policy. Pair every hit with the member Council Message Board post on the same item before seating a chair.
council_voting_record.climate_negative: Only 4 contested climate items, and nearly every climate dissent in the whole dataset is Mackenzie Kelly, a FORMER member. The current council is effectively unanimous on climate, so votes cannot discriminate there and the message board is the only climate path.
